Alex — thanks for the clear asks. Putting proposed answers below so we have a written record ahead of any call.

1) Evidence cadence: Redwood provides a quarterly SOC 2 snapshot (rolling reports) plus a continuous evidence bundle for operational artifacts (e.g., rotation logs, change logs) on request. Typical turnaround for on-demand evidence is 3 business days for most artifacts; for custom exports (longer log retention exports) allow up to 7 business days. We can document the exact artifact list against your checklist on the call.

2) Pen-test window: Week of 2026-09-13 works in principle. Redwood requires scoped staging access for active-testing. We do not require a contract carve-out if the security exhibit in the MSA/order form explicitly grants short-lived test access and the notification/fallback process is followed. If you prefer, legal can include a 7-day notice exception in the exhibit; otherwise we rely on the standard exhibit with an agreed window.
